comment: Wrist-image servo at the pre-grasp hover, which lies on the approach axis of the grasp pose (task.on_axis), so the view is fixed in the gripper frame. J: px change per metre of gripper shift along (u = closing axis toward the fixed jaw, w = u rotated +90 deg). target: cube centroid px for a good grasp. Released (contact) cube appears at ~(767, 347); a grasp succeeded at (818, 335).
